clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope  -  Requirements for floor door  stopper suitable for use with door shutters of 30, 35, 40, and 45 mm thickness.

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 2. Materials a) For Body or Housing and Cover Plate— Aluminium alloy (pressure die) castings  or aluminium alloy sheets or brass sheet  or  cast brass or brass gravity  die  casting. b) For Spring— Phosphor bronze or  hard drawn steel wire. c) For Tongue—Aluminium alloy pressure die casting or cast brass or nylon or plastic.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Requirements a) Four countersunk holes for fixing door stopper to floor. b) Body or housing shall be cast in one piece  and fixed to cover plate by brass  or mild steel screws. c) Rubber piece shall be attached to extreme end to absorb shocks.

clauses.title: Dimensions (in mm)
clauses.text: 4. Dimensions (in mm) Thickness of door 30 35 40 45 shutter Overall length of 140 140 150150 cover plate Width of cover plate. 40 40 40 40 Thickness of cover plate 4.5 for castings 3 for sheet metal

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4.1 Tolerances a) On overall length of cover plate ± 0.5 mm b) On thickness of cover plate + 0.3 mm and - 0mm. Note —For detailed dimensions and tolerances,  refer to Table 2 to be  with Fig. 1 of  the standard.

clauses.title: The stoppers shall be
clauses.text: 5.1 The stoppers shall be well made and free from defects likely to prevent its correct fixing or affect adversely its reliability in use.

clauses.title: Body or housing shall
clauses.text: 5.2 Body or housing shall be cast in one piece and fixed to cover plate by brass or mild steel screws.

clauses.title: There shall be four
clauses.text: 5.3 There shall be four countersunk holes for fixing stoppers to the floor.

clauses.title: On the extreme end,
clauses.text: 5.4 On the extreme end, a rubber piece shall be attached to absorb shocks due to pulling action of door. The rubber used shall comply with the following requirements: a) Relative density, Max       1.3 b) Hardness 60 ± 5 c) Ageing for 24 h at i) Change in 100 ±10C initial hardness +5, - 0 ii) Shall not develop brittleness or tackiness

clauses.title: Workmanship and Finish
clauses.text: 6. Workmanship and Finish —  Stoppers shall be free from flaws and defects of all kinds. Aluminium door stoppers shall be anodized and brass stoppers be finished smooth. Stoppers may also be chromium or nickel plated, anodized or oxidized. The exterior of door stopper shall be flush with floor and be finished bright or satin.
